stories.title: Dockworkers strike at 100+ ports against arms shipments
stories.summary: Dockworkers at more than 100 ports across Europe, the Mediterranean and North America struck Friday against arms shipments and for better working conditions, with unions in France, Italy, Greece, Spain, Turkey and Morocco joining. Experts expect only limited impact on global supply chains.

stories.title: Russia's Novaya Gazeta newspaper to shut down
stories.summary: Russia's most prominent independent newspaper, Novaya Gazeta, announced it will close Nov. 9 after more than three decades, blaming relentless government pressure. The outlet accused authorities of forcing its editorial team to stop work.

stories.title: Three tankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said three oil tankers, including a supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels, exploded and caught fire Friday in the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. military denied Iranian claims about naval mines, saying primary transit routes are clear.

stories.title: Final results confirm Netanyahu bloc lost majority
stories.summary: Final election results confirmed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc lost its parliamentary majority, with Arab-led parties holding 19 seats. Weeks of difficult coalition negotiations among sharply different parties now lie ahead.

stories.title: Binance hit by record $6B+ crypto heist linked to North Korea
stories.summary: More than $6 billion in crypto was drained from Binance in what is being called the largest crypto heist on record, with investigators linking the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor hacking group. Exchanges are racing to freeze roughly $2.7 billion already flagged.

stories.title: Trojanized Claude Code extension planted SSH backdoor
stories.summary: A malicious build of Anthropic's Claude Code extension (v2.1.313) pushed through the Cursor marketplace and Open-VSX installed a persistent SSH backdoor on developer machines. Cursor said up to 5,000 users received the trojanized update over an 11-hour window.

stories.title: OpenAI to honor shared robots.txt signal for AI training
stories.summary: OpenAI said it will honor a shared signal in robots.txt that lets website operators communicate AI-training preferences to multiple providers at once. The move builds on an IETF AI Preferences working group effort aimed at simplifying publisher controls.

stories.title: Stefanski's late third-down call dominates Browns fallout
stories.summary: Friday's Browns newswire is dominated by the fallout from a 24-20 loss in Seattle, where a P.J. Walker interception on a fateful third-and-3 set up the Seahawks' winning score and put Kevin Stefanski's late play call under scrutiny.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. USC: who has the edge in Big Ten showdown
stories.summary: A matchup breakdown weighs injuries, key battles and a prediction for No. 2 Ohio State's Saturday visit to USC, where the Trojans need a win to keep their season alive in the teams' first Big Ten meeting.

stories.title: Ohio State still chasing first win at USC since 1946
stories.summary: No. 2 Ohio State heads to the LA Memorial Coliseum still seeking its first win at USC since 1946, a streak on the line in one of Week 9's biggest games.

stories.title: Antonelli can clinch F1 title as Mexico City practice begins
stories.summary: First practice is underway for the Mexico City Grand Prix, where Kimi Antonelli can clinch his first Formula 1 title with a ninth-place finish Sunday. Norris, Verstappen and Russell were among 10 drivers sitting out the session.

stories.title: Antonelli on verge of becoming F1's youngest champion
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli arrived in Mexico City on the verge of becoming Formula 1's youngest champion, missing Thursday's media day with a viral infection but expected back for Friday practice. Ninth place or better secures the title Sunday.

stories.title: 911 service restored in Columbus area after interruption
stories.summary: 911 service was restored in the Columbus area Friday after an interruption that affected emergency calls, authorities said.

stories.title: Ohio child marriage law under scrutiny after Vinton County case
stories.summary: Ohio's child marriage law is under renewed scrutiny after the Vinton County case in which 16 children were found living in squalid conditions at a single home.

stories.title: Morse Road crash on Northeast Side injures five
stories.summary: A crash shut down Morse Road on Columbus' Northeast Side Friday morning and sent five people to area hospitals, police said.
